about_blocks.text: Terradyne Wellness Center is a renowned facility that specializes in addiction, substance abuse, and chronic relapse. Located on the beautiful Nova Scotia coast, the center provides personalized evidence-based treatment to empower clients to regain control of their lives. With a range of programs, Terradyne serves as a beacon of hope for individuals struggling with addiction or substance abuse.

about_blocks.text: Terradyne Wellness Center offers a range of services to cater to the unique needs of each client. Their inpatient program runs for 21-90 days and is designed to provide a safe and supportive environment for individuals on the path to recovery. Additionally, the facility offers continuing aftercare to ensure that clients receive adequate support to maintain their sobriety and transition back into their daily routine.

about_blocks.text: Terradyne’s team of professionals provides expert care, including personalized and professional coaching to help clients reintegrate into society confidently. They offer occupational transition planning and practical skills that empower clients to succeed in their lives and careers.

about_blocks.text: Terradyne’s clinical team boasts a range of experience and certifications in therapeutic approaches like CBT, DBT, mindfulness, strengths-based therapy, and trauma-informed therapy. Clients receive 1-on-1 therapy around twice a week and participate in educational workshops that focus on relapse prevention, goal setting, positive psychology, emotional intelligence, or solution-focused planning.

about_blocks.text: Terradyne Wellness Center is located in an ideal setting along the Nova Scotia coast, with comfortable, updated furnishing. Clients start their day with meditation or exercise and engage in educational workshops before lunch. After lunch, they have access to various recreational activities such as hiking, personal training, or off-site 12-step meetings. The day ends with yoga classes, Reiki sessions, sound healing workshops, music therapy sessions, movies, and games.

about_blocks.text: Our team of professionals at Terradyne have decades of experience and incorporate a wide variety of recovery approaches to treat addiction. Our team includes doctors, psychiatrists, therapists, counsellors and other specialists who work together to address the individual needs of each client. Our approach is not a one-size-fits-all model, we understand that each client is unique and requires individualized care.

about_blocks.text: At Terradyne, our mission is to provide a holistic approach to rehabilitation that addresses not only the addiction but also the underlying causes and mental health issues. Our comprehensive wellness program includes nutritional counselling, physical activity, mindfulness and meditation practices, and other wellness therapies. Our goal is to not only help clients achieve sobriety but to help them rebuild a healthy, fulfilling life, free from the destruction of addiction. We are dedicated to providing the tools and resources necessary for clients to achieve a successful long-term recovery.
